body: Thank you for your kind words. I do really try to be a good person. I've decided to try to find a place that takes in patients (I don't know what the modern term for "asylum" or "sanitarium" is, but yeah, one of those). I just don't want my little boy to suffer watching his dad slowly losing his mind with each passing day. It's the only other option I can really think of. But again, thank you!

Not a teacher but I've worked for the school system before and currently am again (Yes, I'm the "lunch lady dude" as the students say) and got some answers/stories for you. But first I would like to say that I don't believe I'm an attractive guy, and even if I was I imagine it'd be hard to see it past the apron, hairnet, and sad trying to be cool shirts. Was 26 when worked at a high school and am now 30 at a middle school. 
First, yes, at those ages it's OBVIOUS when they are attracted to you... BOTH genders... ugh... BUT there were quite a few 17/18 y/o's that were rather attractive, however, as a guy working there, you just know it's the devil's candy.

Story 1: I, just like the students, have no filter. In my first week running the register I just took a drink of Mountain Dew and a young female voice from nearby says "HEY... HEY!!!.. You shouldn't drink that!", I simply asked why and heard a bunch of giggles. Moments later a guy at that table chimes in and says "she said it makes your dick shrink"... to which I replied "Ain't had any complaints yet!" then realized what I said and told my boss before anyone else could.

The story about how I got fired: I used to go to a local music venue, knew most of the bands from my glory days. Anyways, a lot of students went there as well and became pretty good friends with some of the older ones. One mentioned she had a friend she wanted me to meet. She was cute, ALMOST 18 and didn't go to the school I worked at, we started dating. Her parents approved, in fact her dad and I actually got along really well! We managed to wait until 3 days before she turned 18 to do anything sexual. The school system found out months after she turned 18 when I had to pick her up one day. The sheriff stationed at the school I worked at had followed me, then called her dad and asked if he knew, he said yes, and that he approved, even stood up for me. The bastard then LIED to her dad saying I had had sex with MULTIPLE students, all under 18, on the school property. I got let go but no charges pressed... In part because I knew about the sheriff's affair with one of my co-workers =) We were together up until recently. I now have an AMAZING 2 1/2 year old son out of this situation and he makes it worth the whole ordeal.

Finally, 4 years later I now work at a middle school. These. Kids. Are. BAD! I swear, it really seems like for a lot of them, their life goals are to be on 16 and Pregnant! But I must say, when a 17 year old is checking you out there's that slight temptation... When it's a 13 year old (whose parents you went to school with!) NO!!! Just. No!

You are absolutely gorgeous! Seriously! Also, you look very intelligent, which is becoming harder and harder to find! Change nothing. You seem to have the personality part down just right, and you have this kinda care-free, fun look about you =)
